notes: One class only (0x7104f6b470, 144 bytes); vtable 52 entries (0x00-0x198). Exports without a dossier slot: capture -> vtable +0x78 (f_71003edd10, looks up the catcher and forwards to capture_2 with the catcher's status-derived value), capture_2 -> +0x80 (f_71003ede00), node_offset -> +0x90 (f_71003ee1d0), capture_cut -> +0xA0 (f_71003ee290), thrown_cut -> +0xD8 (f_71003ee960), set_send_cut_event -> +0xE8 (f_71003eedc0), set_update_pos -> +0xF8 (f_71003eede0), set_ignore_catching -> +0x130 (f_71003efae0). Getters holding no field: is_capture (false if own CatchModule is_catch, else LinkModule link tests), catch_object_id (linked parent id via LinkModule), is_catch_hit_stop (LinkModule +0x70 then +0x488), catch_pos_y (y of LinkModule +0x160 at catch_node), node_offset (computed: catch node position minus own capture node position, x/y), capture_to_catch_node_pos_diff (computed: catch_node_pos - capture_node_pos, x and y), motion / motion_lw (computed: hash40 of the given motion extended with a suffix chosen by the int, CRC32 continuation), motion_offset_lw_2 (returns 0 for this class), update_pos_thrown (empty), check_damage / check_damage_thrown (accumulate captured_damage, compare with capture_cut_damage; check_damage may also request a status change through StatusModule +0x48). capture_2 sends a capture event to LinkModule and fills catch_node, motion_offset, motion_offset_lw, motion_hi_lw, ignore_distance and node_link from the catcher's reply, then sets send_cut_event=1, thrown=0, update_pos=1, thrown_finish=0, captured_damage=0 and calls the catcher's CatchModule +0x68 (catching=1). No access found to +0x38..+0x3F and +0x88..+0x8F (padding). Constructor initial values: hashes invalid (0x7fb997a80) at +0x10/+0x18/+0x20/+0x70, zeros +0x28..+0x37 and +0x40..+0x6F, +0x78=-1, bytes +0x7C..+0x87 = 0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1.
